senses.sense_definition: Iets lekkers of een drankje aanbieden en betalen voor anderen, vaak ter gelegenheid van een feestelijke gebeurtenis.

examples.text: Omdat hij jarig was, besloot hij om de hele klas op taart te <w>trakteren</w>.

target_lang_translations.en: Because it was his birthday, he decided to <w>treat</w> the whole class to cake.
target_lang_translations.zh: 因为今天是他的生日，他决定<w>请</w>全班同学吃蛋糕。

examples.text: Maak je geen zorgen over de rekening van de drankjes, ik <w>trakteer</w> vanavond.

target_lang_translations.en: Don't worry about the bill for the drinks, I'm <w>treating</w> tonight.
target_lang_translations.zh: 别担心酒水的账单，今晚我来<w>请客</w>。

target_lang_definitions.en: To offer a treat, food, or drink to others and pay for it, often on the occasion of a festive event.
target_lang_definitions.zh: 为他人提供食物或饮料并支付费用，通常是在庆祝某种节日或特殊场合时。

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: to pay for someone else's food, drink, or entertainment
to pay for drinks for a group of people

zh.target_lang_sense_clarification: 指由某人支付费用招待他人，通常用于餐饮场合。
指支付账单，在口语中常用于表示主动承担费用。
